prompts.male: Create one transparent game TURNAROUND sprite atlas, exactly FIVE equal columns and FOUR equal rows, 20 full-body standing character sprites. No text, no labels, no cell borders. Reference is exact character identity and four seasonal costumes to preserve, polished soft 3D illustration like reference, detailed clothes, big eyes brown hair boots and same body proportions. Columns strictly: (1) FRONT looking at viewer, (2) FRONT-RIGHT THREEQUARTER facing screen right, (3) FULL RIGHT SIDE PROFILE facing screen right, (4) BACK-RIGHT THREEQUARTER facing away/right, (5) FULL BACK facing away with absolutely NO face/eyes visible. Same character rotates in place. Rows strictly spring, summer, autumn, winter. Every sprite stands at same scale with complete head/boots, feet at same relative height, centered in each equal cell, 10% padding, relaxed arms. Genuinely transparent background throughout. Portrait sheet 5 columns x 4 rows of tall sprites. No hats no glasses no scarves no bags. Preserve warm rounded toy proportions, no low-poly geometry. Use ONLY the BOY (top row of reference). Row1 yellow shirt blue denim overalls. Row2 aqua linen shirt cream short overalls. Row3 rust knit cardigan over blue denim long overalls. Row4 teal quilted fur-lined coat and brown long trousers with warm boots. Brown tousled short hair; back views show the back of brown hair. Twenty poses of this same boy only.
